title: EEG: Visual Working Memory in Acute TBI
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from individuals with acute mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) and matched controls performing a visual working memory task with embedded mind-wandering probes. Data were collected at three timepoints spanning approximately four months post-injury, with the initial session occurring 3-14 days after injury. The dataset includes fully preprocessed EEG data and behavioral measures, providing a longitudinal resource for investigating cognitive dysfunction and neural recovery following mild TBI. NOTE: This dataset has not been published and represents work in progress. The principal investigator welcomes collaboration inquiries.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a visual working memory task with interspersed mind-wandering probes. Participants were assessed at three sessions: Session 1 (3-14 days post-injury, including MRI), Session 2 (~2 months post-injury), and Session 3 (~4 months post-injury). Data were collected between 2016-2018 at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair at the UNM Health Sciences Center. All EEG data have been cleaned and preprocessed. Analysis scripts and task code (implemented in MATLAB) are included in the dataset.
